capabilities: Capture tabs in fenced code blocks with chord lines marked by %
Render chords as clickable links opening modal images
Stack all captured chords below the block for side-by-side viewing
Switch the chord diagram instrument in settings
extras: Author notes this is their first plugin; chord images are fetched remotely from ScalesChords, so an internet connection is needed for diagrams.
motivation: The author is learning piano and guitar and wrote the plugin as a way to procrastinate practice.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture tab notation or view chord fingerings alongside lyrics in a note.

relations.evidence: Thanks to the fine folks at ScalesChords who provided an API for generating these images!

summary: Music plugin that renders guitar and piano tab blocks, turning chords into clickable links to chord diagrams.
